newsitem.title: UK: Tatneft set for Dec 18 debut on LSE.
newsitem.headline: Tatneft set for Dec 18 debut on LSE.

text.p: Dealings in the American Depositary Shares of AO Tatneft are set to start on the London Stock Exchange on December 18, the company said in a statement.
The ADS issue, which was priced at $45.00, comprised 2.326 million ADS, each equivalent to one underlying share.
"The global offering was significantly oversubscribed at this price," Tatneft said.
There is a 15 percent overallotment option, which if exercised in fuill will increase the number of ADS to 2.675 million.
"The global offering and the succesful listing of the ADS on the London Stock Exchange are important steps for Tatneft and Tatarstan," Tatarstan's deputy prime minister Ravil Muratov said.
Tatneft, which is based in the Russian republic of Tatarstan, is one of the largest oil producers in Russia with annual output of 25 million tonnes of crude oil in 1995.
It has proven reserves of 841 million tonnes, according to consultants Miller and Lents.
"We are delighted by the strong interest in out global offering and in the high level of oversubscription," said Rinat Galeev, Tatneft's president.
Dresdner Kleinwort Benson was global c-oordinator, lead manager and bookrunner for the ADS offering.
